parameters.name: chargeType
parameters.description: The billing method. Valid values: payasyougo (pay-as-you-go) and subscription.

parameters.name: commodityCode
parameters.description: The commodity code. Example: On Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com), the commodity code for pay-as-you-go is odps and the commodity code for subscription is odpsplus. On Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com), the commodity code for pay-as-you-go is odps_intl and the commodity code for subscription is odpsplus_intl.

parameters.name: commodityData
parameters.description:
The commodity specifications of the quota.

><notice>

- This parameter is required only for subscription quotas.
The minimum unit for cu is 50.
ord_time supports monthly (month) and yearly (year) billing.

- After creation, commodityData cannot be modified. To modify it, go to the MaxCompute console.

></notice>

parameters.name: partNickName
parameters.description: ><notice>This parameter is required only for subscription quotas.></notice>
